title: Reading Drill — Testing temporary path closures — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Testing temporary path closures — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The park planner in Bramley received an old report about walkers following an old path when repairs begin. The report compared entries onto closed paths, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the site observations rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered ten weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include walking events. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed paired notices at junctions as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
